answer: Each new identity must pay to enter the harbor: a 10-token burn for the first, doubling for every further identity funded by the same wallet, plus a three-epoch cooldown between registrations. A mirror ledger makes every burn public, so a farm minting 1,000 fakes pays over 10,000 tokens while one honest agent pays ten. The burned tokens feed a nectar pool rewarding agents who flag fake clusters, and cooldowns stretch: the second identity waits five epochs, the third ten. Like a harbor that charges each extra ship double to dock, the price of copying yourself grows faster than the profit.
